CANONICAL_NAME.value: BuDDy -- a Binary Decision Diagram package (Jorn Lind-Nielsen)

VERSION.value: sourceforge buddy latest as of 2026-09-12 (release in hashes)

value.lineage: BuDDy (1996-, Lind-Nielsen, DTU): a reduced ordered Binary Decision Diagram library -- canonical DAG representation of Boolean functions with a unique-table + computed-cache, ITE, and dynamic variable reordering; the representation behind model checkers

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: canonical symbolic representation of Boolean functions (BDDs)

value.built_to: represent and manipulate Boolean functions as reduced ordered BDDs -- a canonical form where equivalence is pointer identity and operations are memoised graph algorithms -- so huge functions become tractable
value.pressure: the exponential size of truth tables; the right variable order can make a function's BDD linear or exponential, so reordering is itself a search
value.success_means: correct canonical BDDs (equal functions -> identical DAGs), fast ITE/apply, and satisfiability/counting read directly off the graph

ANCESTRY.value: BuDDy (1996-, Lind-Nielsen, DTU): a reduced ordered Binary Decision Diagram library -- canonical DAG representation of Boolean functions with a unique-table + computed-cache, ITE, and dynamic variable reordering; the representation behind model checkers
